# Sugggest

> > Sugggest is a software discovery platform helping users find alternatives and explore tools across operating systems, development, design, productivity, and utilities.

The platform covers software recommendations spanning Microsoft Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS ecosystems. It features detailed pages on productivity tools, development platforms, creative software, system utilities, and streaming services.

## Key Topics

- Windows
- macOS

- Android
- iOS

- collaboration
- API development
- automation
- storage-analysis

## Platform Overview

- [Sugggest: Discover Alternative Software Solutions](https://sugggest.com/software/top-similar-sites): Alternative website discovery tool for finding platform substitutes

## Operating Systems

- [Windows 10: Latest Operating System from Microsoft](https://sugggest.com/software/windows-10): Microsoft Windows 10 OS with Start menu, Edge browser, and Cortana

## Development & Automation Tools

- [Visual Studio Code: Free, Open-Source Code Editor](https://sugggest.com/software/visual-studio-code): Microsoft's free code editor with Git integration and extensions
- [Postman: Comprehensive API Development and Testing Platform](https://sugggest.com/software/postman): API development platform for HTTP testing and collaboration
- [Ansible: Open-Source Automation Tool](https://sugggest.com/software/ansible): Red Hat automation tool for infrastructure-as-code with YAML playbooks

## Creative & Design Software

- [Adobe Photoshop: Industry-standard image editing and manipulation](https://sugggest.com/software/adobe-photoshop): Adobe Creative Cloud image editor for photo manipulation & design
- [Autodesk AutoCAD: Professional CAD Software for Precise Designs](https://sugggest.com/software/autodesk-autocad): Autodesk CAD software for 2D/3D design in architecture & engineering
- [Aseprite: Pixel Art and Sprite Animation Software](https://sugggest.com/software/aseprite): Pixel art and sprite animation tool for 2D game graphics
- [Adobe Firefly: Media Cleanup and Video Editing Tool](https://sugggest.com/software/adobe-firefly): Adobe AI-powered video editing with cleanup and stabilization features
- [Microsoft Paint: Simple Raster Graphics Editor](https://sugggest.com/software/microsoft-paint): Windows built-in raster graphics editor for basic image editing

## Productivity & Collaboration

- [Microsoft OneNote: Digital Notebook for Seamless Note-Taking](https://sugggest.com/software/microsoft-onenote): Microsoft 365 digital notebook with cloud sync and collaboration
- [Pocket: Read-It-Later Service](https://sugggest.com/software/pocket): Read-it-later service for bookmarking articles & offline reading
- [AnyDesk: Fast & Lightweight Remote Desktop Software](https://sugggest.com/software/anydesk): Cross-platform remote desktop software for Windows, macOS, and Linux
- [Spacedesk: Extend Your Desktop Screen Real Estate](https://sugggest.com/software/spacedesk): Use tablet as wireless second display for Windows, Mac, or Linux

## System Utilities & File Management

- [TreeSize: Disk Space Manager for Windows](https://sugggest.com/software/treesize): Windows disk space analyzer by JAM Software for storage management
- [gdu (Go Disk Usage)](https://sugggest.com/software/gdu): Go-based CLI disk usage analyzer for Linux and macOS
- [TeraCopy: Faster File Transfer Utility](https://sugggest.com/software/teracopy): Windows file transfer utility by Code Sector with verification features
